summary: Welcome footer 4-style responsive contract testing. The main reported issue (blank space at 880-1024px range, especially 930px) is FIXED. Footer now correctly shows 4 columns in a single row at 930px and 1024px. Secondary issues found at 700px, 820px (single-column-stacked instead of 2x2), and 1179px (3+1 layout instead of 4-column).

ui_bugs.issue: At 700px and 820px (compact tablet range 560-879px), footer shows single-column-stacked layout (4 rows) instead of expected 2x2 grid (2 rows). Column widths are 322px and 370px respectively, which are too wide to fit 2 per row in the container.
At 1179px, footer shows 3+1 layout (3 columns on row 1, 1 on row 2) instead of expected 4-column single row. This is in the tablet-four-column range (880-1279px).

action_items: MAIN ISSUE FIXED: 930px and 1024px now show 4-column single row layout with no excessive blank space
OPTIONAL: Review compact tablet (560-879px) column width calculation - currently columns are too wide for 2x2 layout
OPTIONAL: Review 1179px layout - currently showing 3+1 instead of 4-column single row
context_for_next_testing_agent: Welcome footer 4-style responsive contract: (1) phone <560px: 2x2 grid PASS, (2) compact tablet 560-879px: should be 2x2 but showing single-column-stacked, (3) tablet-four-column 880-1279px: 930px/1024px PASS with 4-column single row, but 1179px shows 3+1 layout, (4) desktop >=1280px: 1440px PASS with 4-column single row. Main issue at 930px is FIXED.
